mapper.select: SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.consultantabltymng.mapper.EvlparMngMapper.selectEvlparMngList : 평가지관리 LIST */ BB.USER_ID , MAX(EE.FLNM) AS FLNM , SUM(CC.NIGHT_WORK_HR) AS NIGHT_WORK_HR , SUM(CC.PENSN_SUM_AMT) AS PENSN_SUM_AMT , MAX(CC.APRV_YN) AS APRV_YN FROM AYC110 AA /* 근무배정표_월별 */ , AYC100 BB /* 근무배정표_일별 */ , AYC350 CC /* 야간근무수당 */ , SAA200 DD /* 사용자 */ , SCA100 EE /* 종사자 */ WHERE 1=1 AND AA.CRTR_YM = #{yyyyMm} AND BB.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = AA.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AND BB.CRTR_YM = AA.CRTR_YM AND CC.GIVE_YM = AA.CRTR_YM AND CC.CONSTT_ID = BB.USER_ID AND DD.USER_ID = BB.USER_ID AND EE.ENFSN_NO = DD.ENFSN_NO GROUP BY BB.USER_ID ORDER BY 1

SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.etxpyreqstdmng.mapper.NgtmWorkEtxpyReqstdMngMapper.selectNgtmWorkEtxpyReqstdMngDetail : 야간수당신청서상세 LIST */ BB.USER_ID , EE.FLNM , BB.WORK_YMD , 0 AS WORK_TIME , AA.BGNG_HR || ' ~' || AA.END_HR AS DEF_WORK_TIME FROM AYC110 AA /* 근무배정표_월별 */ , AYC100 BB /* 근무배정표_일별 */ , SAA200 DD /* 사용자 */ , SCA100 EE /* 종사자 */ WHERE 1=1 AND AA.CRTR_YM = #{yyyyMm} AND BB.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = AA.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AND BB.CRTR_YM = AA.CRTR_YM AND BB.USER_ID = #{userId} AND CC.GIVE_YM = AA.CRTR_YM AND CC.CONSTT_ID = BB.USER_ID AND DD.USER_ID = BB.USER_ID AND EE.ENFSN_NO = DD.ENFSN_NO ORDER BY 1, 3
